name: Find Bingles
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Find Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 15, 1,320 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Find Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
quests.objectiveText: Find and return Bingles' supplies: Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and Bingles' Blastencapper.
